convert_pytorch_checkpoint_to_tf: convert a PyTorch BertModel checkpoint to a TensorFlow checkpoint and save it to a directory
run_convert_cli: run the CLI tool to convert a PyTorch BERT checkpoint to TensorFlow using command-line arguments
create_tf_var: create a TensorFlow variable from a NumPy tensor with a given name in a TF session
to_tf_var_name: transform a PyTorch variable name to its corresponding TensorFlow variable name
main: run the main entry point to convert a PyTorch BERT checkpoint to TensorFlow via argparse
